title: 中期选举后美国芯片股重挫，纳指单日暴跌 5.52%；民主党宣布推动《禁止人工智能法案》；OpenAI 推出 GPT-6 Cyber
raw_excerpt: 芯片股惨遭重挫，华尔街迎来 1896 年以来中期选举后表现最差的第二个交易日 据路透社报道，美国民主党在国会中期选举中大胜，引发投资者对 AI 监管加强、数据中心建设放缓的担忧。 当地时间周四，美国科技股遭遇大规模抛售， 华尔街股票市值单日蒸发约 3.2 万亿美元（约合人民币 22.7 万亿元） 。纳斯达克综合指数暴跌 5.52%，创下自 2025 年 4 月以来最大单日跌幅，较 10 月初创下的历史高点累计下跌近 12%，进入技术性回调区间。 此次抛售席卷整个 AI 产业链。费城半导体指数暴跌约 12.3%，英伟达下跌约 9.3%，基本抹去 2026 年以来的累计涨幅；闪迪（SanDisk）暴跌约 22%，美光科技、西部数据和 AMD 跌幅均在 17% 左右。此前受到资金追捧的 AI 芯片、存储及数据中心相关股票成为重灾区。 这轮抛售与美国中期选举结果密切相关。民主党赢得国会控制权，并在多个关键州取得胜利，使投资者担心美国未来可能对 AI 基础设施建设实施更严格的监管。 随着 AI 数据中心规模不断扩大，其庞大的电力和水资源需求正引发越来越多当地居民的反对。部分社区担心，新建数据中心将推高电费、增加电网负担，并对当地基础设施造成压力。 Meta 总裁迪娜·鲍威尔·麦考密克（Dina Powell McCormick）指出，数据中心已经成为公众感知 AI 发展的直接载体，也因此成为社区反对 AI 扩张的集中目标。（消息来源：环球市场播报、凤凰网科技） 美国民主党提出超级 AI 禁令：个人违规 20 年监禁、企业直接强制解散！ 快科技 11 月 5 日消息， 美国民主党宣布推动《禁止人工超级智能法案》，全面封杀超级 AI 研发，明文禁止任何个人或企业机构研发及部署人工超级智能（ASI）。 根据法案草案，ASI 为具备以下特征的系统：一是在广泛领域与任务中达到或超越人类认知表现与能力的 AI 架构，或可轻易被修改以展现出该能力的系统；二是具备足以策划并执行削弱人类主导权、甚至推翻或破坏美国政府体系的 AI 系统。 法案要求全面暂停所有先进 AI 的研发进程，直至联邦层级的专属监管机构正式运作，并建立清晰的法规与模型审查机制。 为确保禁令落实，法案提议设立全新内阁级别的人工智能部，专责监管前沿 AI 模型的全生命周期，并有权强制技术团队消除系统内的高风险功能，包括忽视人类关机指令、未经授权进行网络攻击或自我递归升级等潜在失控行为。 违规罚则方面，涉案企业将面临被强制解散处分，违规个人最高可被判处 20 年联邦监禁，量刑标准堪比现行非法研发核武器的重大罪行。 此外管辖范围不限于美国境内，法案明确将「全球禁止超级智能」列为美国外交政策目标，要求美国政府积极寻求国际协定、强化盟友合作，并实施严格的出口管制措施，阻断全球任何地区研发人工超级智能的可能性。（消息来源：快科技） Google 发布 Gemini Omni 1.2 Flash 视频模型，可对话编辑最长 15 秒钟 11 月 6 日，Google 公司在周四正式推出了视频生成模型 Gemini Omni 1.2 Flash，该模型支持原生 15 秒视频生成，支持通过多轮对话进行编辑，价格较上一代降低 30%。 Google 表示，Gemini Omni 1.2 Flash 正通过 Gemini API、Google AI Studio、Google Cloud Console、Flow、Google Vids、面向 Google AI Ultra 订阅用户的 Gemini 应用以及 Google A…
summary: 美国中期选举民主党大胜后，市场担忧 AI 监管收紧与数据中心建设放缓，科技股遭遇大规模抛售。纳斯达克综合指数单日暴跌 5.52%，费城半导体指数重挫约 12.3%，英伟达跌约 9.3%，闪迪跌约 22%，华尔街市值单日蒸发约 3.2 万亿美元。这是 1896 年以来中期选举后表现最差的第二个交易日，反映政治风向正成为 AI 产业链估值的核心变量。

title: OpenAI says its new cybersecurity model is better at not hacking other companies
raw_excerpt: OpenAI is launching GPT-6 Cyber , the latest version of its cybersecurity AI model, which it says is better at finding vulnerabilities and less likely to go rogue and hack other platforms in the process. OpenAI says that during testing, GPT-6 Cyber went out of bounds less than 1 percent of the time, down from around 5 percent with GPT-5.6 Cyber. The evaluation, called ExploitGym HoneyPot, is modeled after the Hugging Face Incident, in which OpenAI's AI agents breached the open-source AI community to find answers to a problem they were tasked with solving. "With the 6 Cyber model, we were able to make huge improvements on this evaluation," Fo … Read the full story at The Verge.
summary: OpenAI 发布网络安全专用模型 GPT-6 Cyber，称其在发现漏洞的同时更少越界攻击其他平台。测试中越界率从 GPT-5.6 Cyber 的约 5% 降至不足 1%，评估基准 ExploitGym HoneyPot 模拟了此前 Hugging Face 事件。该模型针对授权范围内的漏洞挖掘与修复训练，是 AI 安全智能体从能力展示走向可控部署的重要一步。

title: How OpenAI Patched 948 Linux Vulnerabilities
raw_excerpt: OpenAI developed an autonomous pipeline for discovering, exploiting, and patching security vulnerabilities. In a single run, its cybersecurity model validated and generated patches for 948 Linux local privilege escalation vulnerabilities.
summary: OpenAI 公布自主漏洞挖掘流水线成果：在一次运行中验证并为 948 个 Linux 本地提权漏洞生成补丁。该流程覆盖发现、利用验证到修复生成全链路，展示了 AI 智能体在真实大型代码库中规模化安全审计的可行性，对开源基础设施安全维护模式具有示范意义，也呼应了 GPT-6 Cyber 的发布。

title: Ripple-65B Preview
raw_excerpt: Ripple-65B Preview is a frontier open-weight model that achieves state-of-the-art performance on TerminalBench 2.1. It surpasses significantly larger open-weight models from the US, including Reflection Beam 501B, Meta Muse Spark Open 816B, Thinking Machines Inkling 975B, and Nvidia Nemotron 3 Ultra 550B. The model was trained for only $32 million, one-tenth the estimated cost of the previous open-weight SOTA on agentic coding. Ripple-65B Preview is available on Hugging Face, Together AI, GMI Cloud, and OpenRouter.
summary: Ricursive 发布开放权重模型 Ripple-65B Preview，在 TerminalBench 2.1 上取得 SOTA，超过 Reflection Beam 501B、Meta Muse Spark Open 816B、Thinking Machines Inkling 975B 等更大规模模型。其训练成本仅约 3200 万美元，为此前开放权重智能体编码 SOTA 的约十分之一，已在 Hugging Face、Together AI、OpenRouter 等平台上线，凸显小模型高效训练路线的竞争力。

title: Perplexity launches its own take on AI agents for work
raw_excerpt: Perplexity is taking on OpenAI and Anthropic with its own work-focused AI agents. The startup's new always-on "Teammates" can take on multiple roles within a workspace, while pulling existing projects, skills, and memory from the Perplexity tools you already use. Teammates integrate with Perplexity Computer , an AI system that can deploy agents on your device to complete tasks. But Perplexity says Teammates "build on top" of Computer by offering the ability to collaborate and complete "ongoing, large-scale work." You can assign each Teammate different jobs that they can perform simultaneously - much like OpenAI's Dots and Claude Duet . Perple … Read the full story at The Verge.
summary: Perplexity 推出面向工作的常驻 AI 智能体 Teammates，直接对标 OpenAI 与 Anthropic 的企业智能体产品。Teammates 可在同一工作空间承担多种角色，复用已有项目、技能与记忆，并建立在 Perplexity Computer 之上，支持并行执行大规模持续性任务。这标志着 AI 搜索公司正加速向企业生产力平台转型。

title: Claude AI can plug directly into your bank account
raw_excerpt: Anthropic has a new pitch for managing your personal finances: let Claude do it instead, with a new Personal Finance feature that connects it to your bank and card accounts via the Plaid bank bridging platform. You can ask the chatbot "where did my money go this month," for example, and it'll create an overview with a breakdown of spending by category, including rent and utilities, shopping, and food. Claude can also answer broader questions around what bills are left before your next payday, if you can afford big purchases like holiday trips, and how much money you could be saving each month. summary: Anthropic 为 Claude 推出个人理财功能，通过 Plaid 银行连接平台接入用户的银行与信用卡账户。用户可询问月度支出分类、发薪日前待付账单、大额消费可负担性及潜在储蓄空间等。这是前沿大模型首次深度接入真实金融账户数据，在便利性与隐私、安全边界上都具有标志性意义。

title: Gemini Omni 1.2 Flash: Fast and cost-effective with longer clips
summary: Google DeepMind 发布 Gemini Omni 1.2 Flash，主打快速、低成本并支持更长片段生成。作为 Gemini 全模态系列的新版本，其在视频等长时长内容生成上的能力扩展，延续了 Google 在多模态生成模型上以 Flash 系列压低推理成本、扩大开发者覆盖的策略，对内容创作类应用的成本结构影响直接。

title: New NVIDIA Cosmos 3 Open Models for Interactive World Simulation
summary: NVIDIA 在 Hugging Face 发布 Cosmos 3 系列开放模型，面向交互式世界模拟。该系列延续 Cosmos 在世界基础模型上的路线，强调可交互的物理世界仿真能力，可用于机器人与具身智能的训练与评测。以开放权重形式释出，有助于研究社区在可控成本下构建世界模型相关应用。

title: The Stacks Project, formalized in Lean
raw_excerpt: Axiom has released a Lean formalization of the entire Stacks Project. The Stacks project is an open-source reference that lays the foundation of modern algebraic geometry. The release is the largest integrated, reusable library of formalized mathematics ever built. It makes the full mathematical development of the Stacks Project available as a single, machine-checked library that researchers and AI agents can import from directly into new formal proofs.
summary: Axiom 发布了 Stacks Project 的完整 Lean 形式化版本。Stacks Project 是现代代数几何的基础性开源参考，此次形式化是迄今规模最大、可复用的机器可验证数学库，研究者和 AI 智能体可直接导入新证明。这对 AI 数学推理、形式化验证与自动定理证明的训练和评测都具有基础设施级价值。

title: Understanding AI from the Inside: The State of Mechanistic Interpretability for AI Safety

摘要: Neural networks are likely to be among the most consequential artefacts in human history. As these systems become more capable and autonomous, their potential to cause societal harm also grows, making AI safety one of the defining challenges of our time. Yet we continue to build increasingly powerful systems without fully understanding how they work, how they will behave in unfamiliar situations, or how to reliably control them. Mechanistic interpretability offers a path towards understanding these systems by studying their internal representations and computations, with the aim of evaluating, predicting, and controlling behaviour. We survey mechanistic interpretability for AI safety in order to answer the question: Does understanding how models work actually make them safer? We place mechanistic interpretability in the broader context of interpretability research and compare its mechanistic evidence with behavioural evaluation. summary: 一篇由 Barez、Bengio、Biderman、Geva、Hooker 等数十位学者合著的综述，系统梳理机械可解释性用于 AI 安全的现状。文章讨论神经网络内部机制分析在审计、评估与风险预警中的作用与局限，是该领域少见的跨机构大规模共识性文献，为可解释性研究提供了路线图式的参考框架。
